moments.action: Bank faces Lynn in the dim laundry while she sits against the wooden door, watching him without moving. By the last shot he has dropped his eyes to the floor.
Lynn frowns at him across the room; Bank's face snaps open in shock, mouth parted, then settles back into a flat stare while she keeps her eyes on him.
Lynn stares in silence, then Bank holds out a yellow leaflet to her, caught in close insert. The framing widens to an over-shoulder two-shot with him facing her squarely and the paper gone from view.
The coverage tightens to warm sunlit profiles, Lynn then Bank. An insert catches the yellow leaflet in mid-air above his outstretched arm, and the moment ends on Lynn in profile, eyes lowered.
A long held profile close-up of Bank against the sunlit wall as he talks on and on. He never turns toward her; the take ends with him still speaking, gaze fixed off-screen.
